typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsAmendUserStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Adent UserID} as string,
		Office_Type as string,
		FullName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> AmendmentUser
AmendmentUser derive(Load_dt = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		FullName as string,
		Office_Type as string,
		Adent_UserID as string,
		loaddate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		FullName,
		Office_Type,
		Adent_UserID = {Adent UserID},
		loaddate = Load_dt),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsAmendUserStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblEndurCommoditiesTradeEventsAmendUserStaging
